description: Renders as an <hr> or <div> with role="separator" to visually and semantically divide content. The decorative prop controls whether the separator is exposed to assistive technology — when decorative is true, aria-hidden="true" is set and the separator has role="none".

focus.notes: Separator is not focusable as it is a static, non-interactive element.

announcements: Non-decorative separators are announced as a separator landmark
Decorative separators (decorative=true) are hidden from screen readers via aria-hidden
screenReader.notes: The orientation prop (horizontal or vertical) is communicated to assistive technology via aria-orientation on non-decorative separators.

contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for the separator line against background)

consumerResponsibilities: Set decorative={true} when the separator is purely visual and carries no semantic meaning
When the separator divides meaningful content sections, leave decorative as false
Use the appropriate orientation (horizontal or vertical) for the layout context
